TSMC 2nm (N2/N2P) Process:
- Wafer cost: ~,000 per wafer
- Mask cost (full set): ~-12M
- Defect density: ~0.20-0.24 defects/cm2
- Gate-All-Around (GAA) Nanosheet architecture
- Backside power delivery network (BSPDN) on N2P
- Transistor density: ~1.15x N3E
- Performance: ~1.15x N3E at same power, or ~0.7x power at same speed
- Reticle limit: 858 mm2 (33mm x 26mm)
- Availability: High volume production 2026+

TSMC 3nm (N3E/N3P) Process:
- Wafer cost: ~,000
- Mask cost (full set): ~-8M
- Defect density: ~0.20-0.25 defects/cm2
- Transistor density: ~1.7x N5
- Performance: ~1.1x N5 at same power, or ~0.5x power at same speed
- Minimum pitch: FinFET, contacted poly pitch ~45nm
- Reticle limit: 858 mm2 (33mm x 26mm)
- Availability: High volume production 2024+

TSMC 4nm (N4/N4P/N4X) Process:
- Wafer cost: ~,000
- Mask cost (full set): ~-5M
- Defect density: ~0.28-0.32 defects/cm2
- Transistor density: ~1.2x N5
- Performance: ~1.07x N5 at same power
- NVIDIA 4NP: custom variant for GPU workloads
- Reticle limit: 858 mm2
- Availability: High volume production 2023+

TSMC 5nm (N5/N5P) Process:
- Wafer cost: ~,000
- Mask cost (full set): ~.5-4.7M
- Defect density: ~0.32-0.38 defects/cm2
- Transistor density: ~1.8x N7
- Performance: ~1.15x N7 at same power, or ~0.7x power at same speed
- Reticle limit: 858 mm2
- Availability: High volume production 2020+
